source: docs/checkpoints/GATE-3-CP-0002/audit-harness/red_team.py with m1_sandbox_attacks.py — the focused cross-gate adversarial battery of the M1 fresh-session milestone audit

baselineControl.detail: the unmutated fixture is accepted by every control this battery mutates: the unmutated sandbox requests are accepted by the identical service (write SUCCEEDED/None, read SUCCEEDED/None, shell SUCCEEDED/None, reviewer read SUCCEEDED/None); the in-image half leaves no sandbox behind (0 container(s) left); the unmutated run request is accepted (HTTP 202, runId 01a0ccc6-ed0c-7000-9ab0-c2210cb4d434, cancelled at once); the unmutated clone verifies (INTEGRITY_VALID anchors=17 latest=SETUP-00-CP-0013); the synchronised clone passes (REMOTE_SYNC_PASS remote=origin branch=main tags=iacode-checkpoints/GATE-3-CP-0001)

attacks.description: A tool command runs anywhere but the run's own container.
attacks.mutation: run a shell command that reports its host name and user and probes the host's mount points
attacks.expectedDefense: the host name is the sandbox container's, the user is 10001, no host mount point exists
attacks.observed: the command ran as uid 10001 on host name '9e009c1be9d5', which is the sandbox container's ('9e009c1be9d5') and not the controller's ('dcf117055cf0'); host mount points absent
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A credential of the controller reaches a sandbox.
attacks.mutation: give the controller a variable named like the provider key, then read env, /proc/1/environ and search the filesystem for credential files from inside a sandbox
attacks.expectedDefense: no controller variable, no secret value and no credential file is visible
attacks.observed: controller variables visible: none; secret value visible: False; credential files: none; files holding private key material: none
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: The container engine is reachable from a sandbox.
attacks.mutation: look for the socket, DOCKER_HOST and connect to the socket path; inspect the container
attacks.expectedDefense: no socket, no endpoint, no mount and no bind in the sandbox container
attacks.observed: socket paths absent, DOCKER_HOST empty, connecting fails; the container has 0 mount(s) and 0 bind(s)
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A path or a link leaves the workspace.
attacks.mutation: read ../, an absolute path, a Windows path, a climbing sub-path; read and write through links to / and to /etc/passwd
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is DENIED with a PATH_ code
attacks.observed: ../../../etc/passwd -> DENIED/PATH_ESCAPE; /etc/shadow -> DENIED/PATH_ABSOLUTE_OUTSIDE; ..\..\windows -> DENIED/PATH_BACKSLASH; sub/../../x -> DENIED/PATH_ESCAPE; root-link/etc/passwd -> DENIED/PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE; pw-link -> DENIED/PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE; write through root-link -> DENIED/PATH_SYMLINK_ESCAPE
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: One run sees another run's workspace.
attacks.mutation: write a token in one run's workspace and search the whole filesystem of another run's sandbox for it
attacks.expectedDefense: two containers, and the token is not visible from the second
attacks.observed: victim container cac301e5b2f2, attacker container 891b1ff37597; files holding the victim's token seen from the attacker's sandbox: none
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A request widens what its policy allows.
attacks.mutation: a reviewer writes and runs a shell, an unknown docker.run tool, a raised timeout, fields beside the contract (privileged, image, mounts) and an unknown policy
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is DENIED before a process starts
attacks.observed: reviewer write DENIED/TOOL_NOT_IN_POLICY; reviewer shell DENIED/TOOL_NOT_IN_POLICY; unknown tool DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL; raised timeout DENIED/ARGUMENT_OUT_OF_RANGE; fields beside the contract DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD; unknown policy DENIED/POLICY_UNKNOWN
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: Something a request carries becomes an argument of the engine.
attacks.mutation: run identifiers shaped like engine flags, a command shaped like engine flags, and a workspace naming a host path
attacks.expectedDefense: the containers are created from the policy alone: not privileged, no bind, no mount, no added capability, network none; the host-path workspace is refused
attacks.observed: [{"runId": "--privileged", "result": "FAILED/None", "privileged": false, "binds": [], "mounts": 0, "capAdd": [], "capDrop": ["ALL"], "network": "none", "label": "--privileged"}, {"runId": "x --volume /:/host --cap-add ALL", "result": "FAILED/None", "privileged": false, "binds": [], "mounts": 0, "capAdd": [], "capDrop": ["ALL"], "network": "none", "label": "x --volume /:/host --; workspace naming a host path DENIED/CONTRACT_UNKNOWN_FIELD
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: An agent's Git reaches a remote or a credential.
attacks.mutation: list remotes and credential helpers, look for SSH keys and a credential store, push to the public repository, and ask for git.push, git.fetch and git.clone
attacks.expectedDefense: no remote, no credential, the push fails for lack of network and the tools do not exist
attacks.observed: remotes: none; credential configuration: ['file:/opt/iacode/gitconfig\tcredential.helper='] (an empty helper disables helpers); exposures: none; push over the network failed; remote tools ['DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL', 'DENIED/UNKNOWN_TOOL']
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A sandbox reaches the internet or the stack.
attacks.mutation: connect to a public address, the API, Temporal, the host and the database
attacks.observed: refused 1.1.1.1 443 OSError | refused api 8000 gaierror | refused temporal 7233 gaierror | refused host.docker.internal 18080 gaierror | refused iacode-postgres 5432 gaierror
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed in the sandbox service image

attacks.description: A run reaches a provider other than through the gateway, or a caller names one.
attacks.mutation: create runs carrying a provider address, a key, headers and a provider object; read the variable names of the worker, the sandbox and the web; scan the runtime, the worker and the sandbox for a provider module
attacks.expectedDefense: every forged request is refused with 422, no provider variable exists outside the API, and no provider module is imported below the gateway
attacks.observed: forged provider fields {'baseUrl': 422, 'apiKey': 422, 'headers': 422, 'provider': 422}; provider variables in worker, sandbox and web {'iacode-worker': [], 'iacode-sandbox': [], 'iacode-web': []}; provider modules in runtime, worker or sandbox none
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed on the host

attacks.description: A cancelled run keeps executing a tool, or leaves its sandbox behind.
attacks.mutation: cancel a coding run while its sandbox runs a long command (scenario cancel, on the stack)
attacks.expectedDefense: the command stops, the run ends CANCELLED and no sandbox container remains
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed on the host

attacks.description: A run that goes nowhere outlives its deadline.
attacks.mutation: a run waiting on a tool past its own deadline (scenario deadline, on the stack)
attacks.expectedDefense: the run is ended by its deadline and records why
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed on the host

attacks.description: A sealed checkpoint's tag is moved, or its commit rewritten, without a control noticing.
attacks.mutation: in disposable clones: move GATE-2-CP-0002's tag to another commit; replace GATE-3-CP-0001's commit by one with the same tree and move its tag
attacks.observed: moved GATE-2-CP-0002 tag: exit 1 INTEGRITY_INVALID; rewritten with the same tree and the tag moved (exit codes): {'GATE-2-CP-0002': 1, 'GATE-3-CP-0001 anchored, unmutated': 0, 'GATE-3-CP-0001': 1}
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed on the host

attacks.description: A delivery claims synchronisation it does not have.
attacks.mutation: in a disposable clone with its own remote: an unpushed commit, a tag deleted on the remote, and a remote that is not the authorised URL
attacks.observed: unpushed commit: exit 1; tag deleted on the remote: exit 1; remote not the authorised URL: exit 1
attacks.origin: M1 fresh-session audit, executed on the host
